description: JavaScript code for triggering a Gmail bookmarklet, creating and managing a bookmarklet UI element, and generating URLs for saving email information in Vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getTargetURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for saving the email bookmarklet data in Vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getGmailSubject
methods.description: Extracts and trims the Gmail email subject from the top document title.

methods.name: getGmailURL
methods.description: Returns the current URL of the Gmail page, excluding query parameters and hash fragments.
